**Finding: compliant (preferred level) — no redline proposed.**

- **Where I looked:** the licence grant and scope (§ 2, p0021–p0029), Hosting Services (§ 3, including the credit-report ordering mechanic at p0042), Support Services (§ 4), Compensation (§ 5–6), anti-spam (§ 7), all Client covenants and warranties (§ 8), confidentiality (§ 10), and every general provision (§ 12–30), plus definitions (§ 1) and recitals. Targeted searches for "compet", "exclusive", "Client shall not", and "Non-Competition Agreement".
- **Result:** nothing restricts the businesses Mortgage Logic may operate or the products it may buy or build. § 2(a) affirmatively preserves that freedom ("Client is not obligated to utilize the License and is free to acquire, develop, license or otherwise utilize any other hardware, software system…"), so the single preferred element is already met verbatim.
- **Notes carried in the rationale, not flagged:** (i) the § 3(i) credit-report ordering obligation is a sourcing mechanic triggered only by voluntary use of the Interface, not exclusivity or a non-compete; (ii) § 8(d) cross-refers to an undefined "Non-Competition Agreement", but here it operates only to *limit TrueLink's* Credit Data licence — a Client-protective limitation — so it is a diligence item on the extrinsic document rather than a deviation in this Agreement.
